output.summary: The claim was denied because the MRI was performed out‑of‑network and was not classified as an emergency. To seek further review you must provide the required emergency documentation, but without it there is no basis for an appeal.

items.text: Provide an emergency attestation confirming the service was an emergency and filed within 72 hours of admission.
Submit the discharge summary documenting the emergency nature of the MRI.
Precedent F-OON-ER does not apply because it only overturns out‑of‑network denials for services that were emergencies; this claim is for a non‑emergency outpatient MRI.
The claim is blocked by the EMERGENCY_REQUIRED gate, so without emergency evidence there is no basis to appeal.
